text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's wrap things up for today—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm falling behind the other girls
when accelerating out of the corners...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping you could show me
how you run, Senpai.
choice_data_list: Oh? Is it time for your dependable future Trainer to step up?
Huh? Is it time for their dependable future Trainer to step in?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, flattery will get you nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Running together might be better than words.
Do you mind if I stay behind a bit to watch her...?
choice_data_list: I don't mind. It'll be useful for you in the future, too.
I don't mind. It will prove useful for you in the future as well.
Maybe I should get more experience conveying things with words alone.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Analyzing the challenges each individual requires,
devising countermeasures, and showing them the way...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It is a fine opportunity to gain such experience
for the day I become a coach myself.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I see. If you're going to become an instructor in the future, that skill will likely be needed far more often.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If you notice any shortcomings while listening nearby,
please do give us your advice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided not to push her physically, opting instead to have her gain experience by putting her training knowledge into words.
